messages:
Nina Roberts: Consolidating action items from the edge-cache postmortem. Please claim owners and add Jira links. Target: owners + due dates by EOD Tue.

Nina Roberts: Actions captured: 1) Add eviction telemetry and a tenant breakout panel. 2) Create emergency workarounds for CPU-backed caches. 3) Update the postmortem runbook with handoff steps and RACI. 4) Run a 6-month recurrence query and tag related incidents. 5) Setup a monthly remediation review cadence.

Omar Khalid: I can own #1 (telemetry + panel). I'll stub a Grafana dashboard and open a ticket. ETA 7 days.

Omar Khalid: Ticket created: OBS-8110 "edge-cache eviction telemetry + tenant panels". Link: https://redwood.app/jira/OBS-8110

Yara Singh: I'll take #2 (emergency workarounds). Plan: add a graceful degrade mode and a short-circuit route. Creating RFC + ticket.

Yara Singh: Ticket: RUNTIME-8342 "cpu-cache workaround: degrade path". Leaving PM consult tag.

Kenji Tanaka: I'll own #3 (runbook + RACI). Suggest RACI: Responsible = oncall owner, Accountable = infra-sre lead, Consulted = runtime, Informed = product. Will add contact rotation.

Kenji Tanaka: Draft runbook snippet will include exact commands for safe restart, eviction check, and who to notify.

Nina Roberts: For #4 backfill, I can run initial queries if Ops grants log access. @FollowupBot can you schedule export of edge logs for last 6 months?

FollowupBot: Export scheduled: edge logs (6 months) -> analytics-bucket (job 2468106000). Reminder set for owner check-in in 48 hours (2468107000).

Yara Singh: One more: add an incident label when eviction rate > X within 5m so we can track recurrence. I'll open a small tools ticket after OBS-8110 lands.

Omar Khalid: OBS-8110 draft includes tenant breakout and a recurrence panel mock. Will post link in the ticket.

Nina Roberts: Summary: owners assigned (OBS-8110 Omar, RUNTIME-8342 Yara, runbook Kenji), export scheduled, RACI agreed. I'll move these into the remediation tracker after tickets have due dates. Please ACK here.

Kenji Tanaka: ACK.

Yara Singh: ACK.

Omar Khalid: ACK.

Nina Roberts: Thanks all. Closing loop unless blockers surface.
